name: deluge
title: Deluge
description: BitTorrent client with a web page, labels and plugins, and a download client Sonarr, Radarr and the other *arr apps know. The first sign-in uses the password deluge: change it at once under Preferences > Interface.

variables.name: PORT_DELUGE
variables.label: Web UI Port
variables.description: Port for the Deluge web page

variables.name: PORT_DELUGE_PEERS
variables.label: Peer port
variables.description: The port other peers reach Deluge on. In Deluge: Preferences > Network > Incoming Port, untick Random and enter this number. qBittorrent's template uses 6881 too: give this one another number when both run on one server

variables.name: DELUGE_DOWNLOADS
variables.label: Downloads folder
variables.description: The folder on this server downloads are saved into, mounted at /downloads (use the folder Sonarr and Radarr see)

auth_note: Not put behind Authelia: its own apps and clients sign in directly (the deploy sheet can still protect it)
